brief:
Directors of a Guardian-produced documentary about Gaza are facing intensified threats from Israeli government officials and far-right activists, rights groups reported. The film, titled NAZA, has drawn condemnation from Israeli political figures since its release.

Human rights organizations have rallied behind the directors in response to the threats. The documentary examines civilian casualties in Gaza, including attacks on residential areas with families inside.

title: Israeli ministers, activists threaten Gaza documentary directors
